buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE 25% : The buyer can increase or decrease the contract quantity or contract duration up to 25 percent at the time of issue of the contract. However, once the contract is issued, the contract quantity or contract duration can only be increased up to 25 percent. Bidders are bound to accept the revised quantity or duration. For lumpsum-based service contracts, the buyer may increase the scope of work and contract value up to 25 percent with the consent of the service provider 2. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC

Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 1. Bidder must submit PAN. 2. Bidder must submit GST Certificate of Odisha & GST 3B Returns of last 6 months. 3. Bidder must submit ISO 9001:2015, 10001:2018, 45001:2018, ISO/IEC 27001:2022 Certificate. 4. Bidder must Certificated for online assessment that covered basic functionality of the GeM portal. 5. The Bidder should be registered with any Central or Government Body/Odisha MSME Registered. (Proof of the same must be submitted in BID). 6. Bidder must submit Turn over Certificate from CA Latest Balance Sheet must be submit along with BID. ( Relevant Documents to be enclosed). 7. The uploaded documents should be authentic and genuine and to the point as per the ATC of BID requir ements. It will be verified in all means, if any document that is unnecessary and not as per BID requiremen t, will be treated as disqualified based on wasting time of Tender Evaluation Technical Committee. 8. Self-Declaration Certificate regarding undertaking that No Family relation with employer working in Dep artment. 9. Bidder must submit CVC Certificate. 10. Buyer shall have all the rights to cancel the BID for any inconvenience occurred without assigning any reason thereof. .
